canon_ref.note: Laken's diary Day 1-2. Placeholder day: his count is his own and this thread is not synced to Erin's calendar (like Tom on Rhir, 1.00C). It is about 22 A.F. by Durene's reckoning.

b3.laken_arrives_and_meets_durene.summary: Laken Godart, a blind Earther, takes one step in a San Francisco mall and finds himself in a forest near Riverfarm. He hears a big girl crying, shares his quiche with her, and Durene lets him sleep in her cottage while she sleeps outside.

canon_ref.note: Laken's Day 2-3. Placeholder day, not synced to Erin's calendar.

b3.laken_tells_off_the_village_children.summary: Laken teaches Durene to cook potatoes and to fish. When six village children come to jeer at her as a freak and pelt her with mud, he raises his cup to them, tells them to get lost, and then teaches her some good insults.

canon_ref.note: Laken's Day 5-8. Placeholder day. Durene has one Skill, [Enhanced Strength], and can lift a wagon.

b3.laken_charms_riverfarm.summary: After Durene lifts Prost's broken wagon, Laken talks her into taking him to the village. Prost and the others take to the blind traveller, and Yesel sends him home with a basket, but they all keep a wall between themselves and Durene.

canon_ref.note: Laken's Day 11-12. Placeholder day. His model is Joshua Norton, the self-made Emperor of the United States.

b3.laken_declares_himself_emperor.summary: Wanting a class, Laken tells Durene of Emperor Norton and, half in jest, proclaims himself Emperor of the Unseen and protector of her house. That night the System grants him the [Emperor] class. Durene panics; Laken is thrilled.

system.name: [Emperor]
system.note: Gained as he falls asleep on his Day 11.

system.name: [Aura of the Emperor]
system.note: No command word; he does not know what it does yet.
